items.title: Structural Stability Certificate missing (building older than 30 years)
items.clause: ANNEXURE-2 2.1 iv. - Valid Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer, if the Building is more than thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate

text:
LETTER OF DEFICIENCY (DRAFT)
File No.: AICTE/RB/CE/2027-28/APP-05
Date: 2026-10-27
Institute: Lakeview School of Technology
Permanent Id: 1-4910119
Application: APP-05 (2027-28)

The following deficiencies were found in the application for Extension of Approval:
1. Structural Stability Certificate missing (building older than 30 years) (Structural Stability Certificate)
   The building is more than thirty years from its completion certificate, so a valid Structural Stability Certificate is required. (building_completion_date = 1981-06-01)
   Handbook: "ANNEXURE-2 2.1 iv. - Valid Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer, if the Building is more than thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate"
   To submit: Upload a valid Structural Stability Certificate.

Draft prepared by Pramaan (advisory). To be reviewed and signed by the competent officer.
